story_overview: At Strawberry Field Farm, Arthur, Maya, Amara and others pick strawberries under an overcast sky. The work is interrupted when Arthur and Maya suddenly stop and stare off-screen with concerned expressions. Later, Arthur appears on Greenway Lane, first walking playfully with a plunger, then marching determinedly down the road with the plunger and a newspaper.

video_prompts:

Sophie: Young girl in a pink-collared floral dress.
Amara: Woman with her hair styled in braids and wearing a green bandana, clad in a plain white t-shirt and dark pants.
Strawberry Field Farm: An expansive outdoor strawberry farm with long, neat rows of low-growing, leafy green plants in dirt patches and a vintage blue truck parked in the field.
the fresh strawberries: Plump, bright red, heart-shaped strawberries with a glossy, seed-dimpled surface and fresh green leafy tops.
Marcus: Black man in a gray collared shirt
Clara: Woman with black hair, wearing a colorful floral apron over a blue-grey shirt
In Strawberry Field Farm on a cloudy day, Maya and Sophie pick the fresh strawberries together in the foreground, placing them into the woven picking basket. In the background, Amara, Marcus, Clara, and other people walk through the field, also picking strawberries.

Arthur: Middle-aged man with reddish-brown hair and sideburns, wearing a brown waistcoat over a white collared shirt.
